notes.title: Quality of Life & Bug fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Quality of life improvements[/h3]

When there are a bunch of items in front of you, then [b]heavy items are pulled first[/b]. This should help you utilize your maximum destruction potential.

Outdoor levels in arcade mode were slightly rebalanced so there is always a better ratio of ammo items vs buildings.

Inventory system received some upgrades too - Full inventory indicator was added, making it obvious when you filled up the inventory  as well as items don't overflow anymore, meaning no items jumping out of your hand into your face.

Pull speed control curve was slightly modified, making telekinesis control slightly easier when you are fully upgraded.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

- Hands sometimes disappeared - shouldn't happen anymore
- Tutorial 3 glass now breaks again
- Buildings are now destroyed more consistently (before even super heavy items could bounce on the first shot, now they will do proper damage)

notes.title: Biggest Update Yet
notes.content:
Hey everyone we just released a new version of StressOut. This update brings new game mode, completely reimagined to fit our initial vision better - build the most chaotic relaxing experience that you can replay multiple times and is always somewhat different and always fun.

[previewyoutube=VBgZRigLCC0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Arcade mode[/h1]

Get through 39 procedurally generated levels, farm the gold and unlock powerful upgrades. We built a brand new upgrade system that sets the foundation for future expansion - more spells, more variety, more destruction.


[b]Win Rewards[/b]

Can you beat the developers? Look for [i]Shavorich[/i] and [i]Otiv[/i]  on leaderboards. Get to top of leaderboards to win a free VR game. Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/9pAqPvb]our Discord server[/url] to see the rules and other ways you can win 

Score is simply calculated by looking at how much time you have left in the last room times 10. So if you have 320.1s on the clock when you finish the run, you will get 3201 points.

[h2]Procedural levels[/h2]

A completely new system has been built from the ground up to allow us to generate all kinds of levels. 

Currently there are only a few archetype levels: 
[list]
[*] Shop - indoor small scale destruction
[*] Warehouse - Medium sized chaos 
[*] Outdoors - Full scale destruction
[*] Ceramics - Juicy and full of cash for upgrades
[/list]

Each of these archetype levels has tons of configurations that can spawn during arcade mode. There are even more configurations as you purchase special unlockable sections. Anyways there is a ton and it’s just going to get better.

[h2]What’s coming?[/h2]

We feel like arcade mode is currently in really early stages of its development so we are planning to extend it with new super powers and greater variety of levels. This should come relatively soon.

We are also thinking of building systems for community such as daily challenges, different variants of arcade mode (melee only anyone?)… Let us know what you would like.

[b]Asymmetric multiplayer[/b] we have an early version of asymmetric multiplayer (a mode where 1 player plays on flat screen and 1 in VR) version in the works and are looking for some testers. Let us know if you want to help.

notes.title: More Destruction!
notes.content:
Hello players of StressOut! We appreciate your support during Early Access.
Update 4 is finally here! This update unfortunately took us longer but this is because we are already working on some exciting features coming later this year. We can't wait to show it to you. But first some of the new things...

[h2]Destructible Ceramics[/h2]
We are adding a set of ceramic items in the game. There is a new level you can [b]access by using the info point in every chapter[/b] that serves as a small demo for those new items. In a later update on we will expand the level and scatter the items throughout the game. Please let us know how it feels or if you encounter any issues in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1143770/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]. 

[h3]Try it now - On Any Info Point[/h3]

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/all/generated/ceramics2/ceramics2-steam-light.gif[/img]

[h2]New Level 12[/h2]
A new level that introduces a next few elements we want to use in the game: Portals and platforms. This will enable us to make bigger and more varied levels.

Level 12 also includes a room made just for explosive weapons we added in the previous update.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/all/generated/Level_12/Level_12-steam-light.gif[/img]

[h2]Improved Weapon Handling[/h2]
Since we introduced physics based weapon handling we had some issues with it, specifically, it was hard to apply the power you wanted, because the weapons would lag behind. Might be ok in other games, but in our game it's the point to smash things with power.

The new and improved system reads your controllers' orientations and movements and applies extra forces in those directions. This way the system is still entirely physics-based, but it's way more responsive.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/all/generated/Tool_Handling/Tool_Handling-steam-light.gif[/img]

Another issue occurred when you teleported you could lose the orientation of the weapon you were holding. So over time, it would get in an annoyingly weird position. We fixed this.

[b]Chapter Fillers[/b]

Humans and items will appear after every completed level.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/all/Chapter_Fillers.png[/img]

[b]Level Fillers[/b]

New objects for external levels and city skyline background.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/all/generated/Skyline/Skyline-steam-light.gif[/img]

[h2]Audio Improvements[/h2][list][*]Music lowers in volume correctly when voice overs are playing.[/*][*]30+ different sound effects and variations added[/*][*]Volume adjusted of majority of sound effects[/*][/list]
We have a LOT to do on audio front before we will consider it finished. 
[h2]Other Improvements[/h2][list][*]8 New Collectable puzzle pieces in levels 6 and on (full set cannot be complete yet)[/*][*]Tutorial Improvements (tutorial 1 & 6)[/*][*]Renamed [b]Party[/b] to [b]Quick Game[/b][/*][/list]
[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/all/Puzzles.png[/img]

notes.title: Explosive Tools, New Levels & QOL Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Explosive Tools[/h1]
You can find the explosive tools in Level 2 and 4 in Chapter 1. Perfect for destroying annoying freezers. 

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/steam-assets/EA2/Nuke_Reddit-m1.gif[/img]

[h1]2 New Levels[/h1]
We are introducing a next few experimental levels in the series - Level 7 and 13. Level 7 starts to pickup a warehouse theme and adds bunch of new experimental items such as fork lifts, conveyor belts, new shelves and other physics items.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/steam-assets/EA2/ForkTruck-m1.gif[/img]

Levels 11 and 13 are there to  help us stress test our physics destruction system and to see how you like large scale destruction.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/steam-assets/EA2/Level_13_Flythrough-m1.gif[/img]

[h1]New Vehicles[/h1]
We have also added new vehicles - we think firetruck is the one that is the most interesting as it's quite OP when thrown around!

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/steam-assets/EA2/Firetruck-m1.gif[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[h3]Walk through any doors[/h3]
It's no secret that the way locomotion currently works is a bit non sensical. For example, why do you have to teleport into the levels instead of just walking in? This confused a lot of new players. We are improving it. You should be able to walk through any doors now.

[h3]Explore after the level finishes[/h3]
Another thing that annoyed new players is the way level ends. There was no time to experiment in a level or find the remaining collectables. You had to retry the level. Some players were also confused by the fact that they were teleported out when they reached rating 4. Now, once you reach rating 4 menu opens that lets you continue/restart/go to lobby. It also shows new stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/0b165cd4b482051f128f65b54bbc8e08ff613600.png[/img]

[h2]Hand Objectives[/h2]
Another thing to help newer players who were lost in the game. A hand menu that will tell you the current objectives. For players that understand the basics this will help them figure it out which collectables they are missing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/ed8c402a6640477d4b679333732c03bcbe11d053.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
As usual, we've fixed some minor bugs all across the game, the most notable one being - pulling sometimes stopped working after destroying a building.

notes.title: Improved Destruction, New Items and More
notes.content:
[h1]More destruction[/h1]
We've made several models fully destructible. No more giant shelves leftovers in the levels. Smash it all. Medium sized items were also added that allow bigger havoc to be made faster.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/steam-assets/new_shelves_destruction_2.gif[/img]

[h1]Party Level Reworked[/h1]
Party mode has been there since early versions of StressOut and it hasn't seen much improvements since. This update changes this.

Our goal with party mode is to give you a level where you go from nothing to fully upgraded destruction machine while giving you bits and pieces of different levels. It's intended so you can challenge your friends. It has a separate upgrade system, starts with mini tutorial in the shop and scales up to large scale building destruction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/d2e723128fa47567dc7a41006a04f246028564d9.png[/img]

[h1]Level 11 Reworked[/h1]
Before Level 11 served as a demo for building destruction, but it didn't play that well. Now we extended it with new buildings and new items. Hopefully making it more interesting.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/steam-assets/new_level_11.gif[/img]

[h1]New Destructible Buildings System[/h1]
Before buildings were made of 2 parts: Hard solid blocks and glass floors that were easily breakable. Since we also added medium sized items in the game this update it felt like they were missing a purpose, so we re-worked the destructible system in a way that every item has its place now.

This new system also comes with performance improvements and we can now put up to 5x more buildings in a level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/63462267f39e63256f48382d906fbbb15d8a5564.png[/img]

[h1]Online Leaderboards[/h1]
So far the leaderboards were accessible only from the game after you finished a level. Today we are introducing [url=http://stressout.net/leaderboards]StressOut.net/leaderboards[/url] where you can check the current standings.

Keep in mind that new records and top places are being automatically posted in our Discord server. Come to [url=https://discord.com/invite/9pAqPvb]StressOut Discord[/url] to join the discussion.


[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Heavier items are shot first[/b] - very useful when different sized objects make different damage (breaking glass just became easier)
[*] Throwing items is way easier now and should work more consistently, and you should be able to throw things further
[*] Combo Indicator added
[/list]

[h1]Smaller tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Locomotion Movement speed increased
[*] New pulling feeling & speed (makes it easier to shoot sideways)
[*] Tools and Weapons weights and shooting powers adjusted
[*] Major building destruction optimizations
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Game lagged when you shot a car
[*] 10+ other smaller bugs fixed
[*] Pulling stops working randomly has finally been fixed!
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access is Live
notes.content:
The moment you have been waiting for has arrived: StressOut's Early Access is live and you can now cause painthem!

Chaos. Havoc. Destruction. A race against time and evil, twisted, yet entertaining AI living in your wristwatch forces you to use weapons and incredible superpowers to destroy a frozen-in-time shopping mall. Find out what happened to others before you and escape this mayhem!

We look forward to hearing your feedback from your intense play sessions. Feel free to start a new discussion in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1143770/discussions/]steam community[/url]. You are also welcome to join our Discord community so you can share your suggestions and feedback in order to help shape the development of the game!

[b]What's coming?[/b]
We feel like we build the foundation on which we can build upon but is by no means complete. Over the next few months existing levels will receive additional polish and improvements to gameplay - from making new objects destructible to adding temporary power ups. This would help breaking the repetitiveness.

Over the duration of early access we plan to [b]at least double the amount of content[/b]. This means adding several new levels to adding new core features and mechanics. It's hard to say exactly what these features will be, because we need the you to help us decide. Some of the things we've been thinking of: Level Editor (that would make it a proper sandbox no?), Infinite Procedural Mode, Daily New Challenges, etc... 

We're offering a special -10% launch discount for Early Access release, which will last only for a couple of days. Unfortunately we made a mistake when releasing so we need to wait a day before discount will show up. We contacted Steam and we are hoping it will be available Today.

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Windows Mixed Reality Support
[*] New Levels 6 & 11
[*] [b]Explosive Crystals[/b] appear in levels 1-6 after you complete the game, making high score chasing more strategic and easier
[*] [b]New leaderboards[/b]
This is a huge one. New leaderboards are integrated with Discord. So if you look for competition and you grind the global leaderboards, you need to join us. World records and top 10 plays are posted there automatically by a bot.
[*] Fixed several issues with locomotion (thanks for reporting everyone!)
[*] Various other bugfixes (100+ smaller issues)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Beta Update 3
notes.content:
[h1]2 Bonus Levels[/h1]

Codename "WTF" levels, because they are nothing like the main game levels. Made purely to abuse the mechanics we built so far. Think no gravity, puzzles, explosions, wtf...?

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/Bonus_Levels.gif[/img]

[h1]Human Ragdolls[/h1]

We implemented the core of human ragdolls, but only added a few to the game so far. The idea is that later levels will be busier. Chapter 1 is only the intro, we don't want to overwhelm the new players.

The important part is, it works and we can use it. Now the question is, how to make the most epic scenarios out of it. Ideas?

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/virtualreality/comments/iz4u0z/we_had_telekinesis_and_humans_feels_satisfying/]See Video on Reddit[/url]

[h1]Explosive Crystals[/h1]

Who doesn't like explosions? The game is much richer with another fun mechanic - red explosive crystals. Throw them into a stack of boxes and enjoy that satisfying scene. The impact shrapnel will activate objects in the area to gain more time faster.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1143770/ss_7c52d3a73288b626d75a80f4468039d9f762a683.600x338.jpg?t=1599324548[/img]

[h1]Collectables[/h1]

There are currently 21 hidden objects in the levels. These collectables will tell you a bit about the world of StressOut and will unlock bonus levels.

[img]https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/Collectables.gif[/img]

[h1]Music[/h1]

StressOut features adaptive music, meaning it will change as you do different things in the game. The main way to change the music is to destroy loads of things while playing.

We are in early stages of music so it will definitely change in the future, but we think we found a good foundation. The groovy funk just makes destroying more pleasurable.

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
One of the things we noticed, was that people didn't realize there are more upgrades, so they wouldn't look for them. Then they would finish the game with 5/21 upgrades and think that's it, while there was much more to the game. We updated the info panels to show your game progress.

We also added 3D messages when you pick up upgrades and collectables. We are experimenting with message system showing time counter and other things, but please let us know if you think it's too much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/ca8df6a0222ab97c5ddeaf8dad7c6b867781e938.png[/img]

[h1]Settings panel[/h1]
Before you could not really configure StressOut in any way. Now we give you some basic options, we will extend it as the time goes on.

Make sure to enable "Beauty" camera if you are recording footage ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/b57ea009fdfc429cbae81c0a1337543452014814.png[/img]

[h1]Loads of other upgrades[/h1]
- Save game reset
- Garage introduction chapter - a full new tutorial
- 100+ voice lines added
- New tools and weapons
- Updated upgrade visuals
- Split up "Pull Speed Control" into a separate upgrade (it's a late game mechanic, so it's probably best if you unlock it instead of just having it at the beginning)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/b5ae8dd7adb7d8dc96a73396c5ea875c36721474.png[/img]

If you would like to support us, the best way to do so right now is to spread the word and give us feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9pAqPvb]Discord[/url].

A huge amount of time was also spent getting the music team and voice over ready. StressOut will get [b]Adaptive Music[/b] as the time progresses. We are really satisfied with the team of 4 musicians and producers we got on board. Join Discord as we plan to share some samples soon!

[/list]
 [olist]

For example, if you wanted to interact with lift interface and extended your index finger it would shoot pressing wrong buttons. Now it won't shoot until the path is clear.[/*]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We just started the work on two new major features:

But don't worry, that's not all, we have 5 new levels in the pipeline as well that should come out with Early Access release that we are hoping to do in roughly 2 months.

You can read more about [url=https://stressout.net/updates/beta-3]the next update here[/url] and about the [url=https://stressout.net/future-plans]future plans here[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - Beta Update 1
notes.content:
[h2]First Week of Beta[/h2]
Thank you all for helping us test StressOut. We have received some invaluable feedback and we worked on it! First update is mostly focused on making improvements and bug fixes to the core of the game.
[h2]Physics Reworked[/h2]
Several people noted that some items are over powered when you hold them in the hand. The reason for this is the fact that items were fixed to your hands when you picked them up, now the items are attached using a "spring". Attaching the items via the spring gives us multiple benefits:
[list][*]1. Items will not be moved around by unstoppable force so they will react properly to environment[/*][*]2. Adjusting the spring strength gives us the ability to give weight to the items (really similar to Half Life Alyx)[/*][/list]
We also added physics to several game objects as you can see at the end of the gif below:

[url=https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/beta-1.mp4.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/4de4566d61a5ed745e07b339479f930f12491e25.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Score System Update[/h2]
So far the game would finish after you activated [b]all items[/b]. Looking for last few items at the end can be really annoying, so we decided to change this and finish the game after you reach rank 4. [b]Time left when achiving the rank 4 will be converted to extra score points.[/b]

To achieve a specific rank you have to:
[list][*][b]Rank 1[/b] - Activate [b]50%[/b] of the items[/*][*][b]Rank 2[/b] - Activate [b]70%[/b] of the items[/*][*][b]Rank 3[/b] - Activate [b]80%[/b] of the items[/*][*][b]Rank 4[/b] - Activate [b]90%[/b] of the items[/*][/list][h2]Other improvements:[/h2][list][*]Hands now colour items on touch[/*][*]Prevent teleporting when hand is inside the wall[/*][*]Improved calculation that determines whether the glass should break or not[/*][*]Increased spell sizes:[/*][*][list][*]Level 1: 4 → 13 items[/*][*]Level 2: 13 → 21 items[/*][*]Level 3: 21 → 29 items[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[url=https://stressout-assets.ams3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/website-assets/beta-2.mp4.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36646777/4de4566d61a5ed745e07b339479f930f12491e25.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*]Staff room now opens after completing level 5[/*][*]Leaderboards long names should be properly shown[/*][*]Leaderboards should correctly show players around your rank[/*][*]Small Spell Cast fix where it would trigger sound and visual effects even if it wasn't casted[/*][*]Reduced glass volume[/*][*]Disable teleportation during level loading (this caused some players to start outside of a level)[/*][/list][h2]Known bugs[/h2][list][*]HTC Vive teleportation has to be reworked (we are aiming to fix this before end of the month)[/*][*]Voice lines are triggering when they are not supposed to (reworked voice line system is going to replace this one soon and it should get fixed at that point, until then, sorry!)[/*][/list]
Especially thanks to all the beta testers who provided feedback 💙: @Kcam99, @Aero, @SteveZero, @PatchPatch, @SammyJspodge, @VirtuallyHealthy, @Phillip (Zilchmasta), @Ms. Switch, @tommy, @Wrarv, @poopendecken.

If you haven't signed up for [url=https://stressout.net/beta]beta[/url] yet, [url=https://stressout.net/beta]please do it here[/url], we would love your feedback.

notes.title: Closed Beta Announcement
notes.content:
We are proud to announce our [b]Closed Beta[/b] for StressOut, the game we've been working on hard for just about a year now. We believe it's the time we move beyond internal testing phase and give it out to the people.

[b]How to join?[/b]
Simply visit stressout.net/beta, enter your email on the website and you will have a chance of winning one of hundreds of keys we will be giving away.

[b]When exactly does the beta start?[/b]
We will be sending out keys in weekly batches and these keys will give you access to the game [b]until Early Access[/b] Launches which we are hoping to do this summer.

[b]Get involved[/b]
The best way to get involved is to spread the word. We want to reward people that helped us make StressOut success. We have plenty of extra keys available that will give you access to the game during both [b]Closed Beta and Early Access[/b] period, so make sure to let us know how you helped and you might get a key!
